definitions.translation: something that spoils something positive (lit. a chip in the joy)

examples.no: regnværet var et skår i gleden
examples.en: the rainy weather put a damper on the joy

examples.no: eneste skår i gleden var at keeperen ble skadd
examples.en: the only thing spoiling the joy was that the goalkeeper was injured

examples.no: skåret i gleden var at faren ikke kunne komme
examples.en: what spoiled the joy was that his father could not come
